name: ODock
author: Marco (hisnameismarco)
description: Fisheye-magnifying dock for the Omarchy shell with continuous pointer magnification, intelli-hide autohide, four edge positions, scroll-to-cycle windows, drag-to-reorder, running indicators, App Expose window grids, launch bounce, and macOS-style glass styling. Derived from davedes' Animated Dock (MIT).
